title: CANS Protocol, Introducing Bitcoin Liquidity to Cardano
description: Having witnessed multiple bull and bear markets, and numerous incidents where cross-chain bridges were hacked, a member of the Cardano community was undeniably highly motivated by the CANS Protocol announcement made by IOG in July. For years, we have faced a significant disconnect in the crypto world. Bitcoin, with a staggering market capitalization of over $1 trillion, possesses the deepest liquidity, but is isolated due to its limited script language from the complex DeFi world. On the other hand, Cardano boasts a mature DeFi ecosystem (DEX, lending, liquidity staking, etc.), yet desperately needs massive external liquidity. The traditional ‘solution’ often comes with compromise. Edmund Judge

title: SecondFi最新进展
description: August Update: In the ongoing investigation and repair, SecondFi's official has revealed several critical updates: Two groups of malicious actors are operating simultaneously. The investigation found that the attacks are not coming from the same organization, but from two independent groups of hackers. The main attacker employs a highly complex and well-funded method, and is currently highly suspected to be the notorious Lazarus Group from North Korea. Simultaneously, another group of independent hackers is launching attacks on different affected wallets. These two groups are even seen competing for stolen funds on the blockchain. Complete Product Shutdown: Given the severe destruction of trust in this security incident, SecondFi's team made a difficult decision to shut down SecondFi and the Yoroi wallet. This name, which accompanied the early days of the Cardano ecosystem, will officially exit history. Safe Wallet Transfer Tool Launched: On August 13, a wallet transfer tool, independently audited by independent security company Bitdefender, has been officially launched. The tool can automatically assist affected users in safely transferring the remaining ADA, native tokens, and NFTs to the users' wallets.

To protect users, EMURGO had already preemptively moved the funds in wallets at risk (approximately 129 million ADA) to safe places. Most wallets are currently safe. The official team has now launched the asset safety migration function. The SecondFi team will also provide asset recovery tools to return the funds to their owners, whether stolen or protected by EMURGO. Absolutely Do Not Do (Fraud Warning): Do not delete your SecondFi app and mnemonic (recovery phrase), keep it as is. Anyone asking for a "private key" or "mnemonic" is a骗子! Do not input your mnemonic in private messages, comments, or any website. Asset Migration Operation Guide Step 1: Confirm if you are affected If you have never used SecondFi or Yoroi, or have only used it through hardware wallets (Ledger/Trezor).
